title: acceptance/S<n>.md front matter
description: A shared acceptance scenario: the tasks it needs (the only place the scenario-task edge is written), its grouping, and any environment it needs. The id comes from the file name; the title and steps from the Gherkin block.

needs.description: Leaf tasks that must all be trusted before the scenario is judged.

category.description: The scenario group, as the feature file's section names it.

environment.description: Where the scenario can be judged. Absent means `local`. A `deployed` scenario is judged only in a run that has a deployed target; until then it waits.

kind.description: `local`: the local test run. `deployed`: the service running in its hosting environment.

setup.description: What must be in place before the run, for the agent that prepares it.
